QuestInfo.name: [PC Cafe] Look for the Legendary Rubies!
QuestInfo.2: During your summer vacation, come to a PC Cafe to search for the Legendary Rubies and receive cool rewards!\nYou'll be swimming in gifts if you pick up the #rLegendary Rubies#k from the monsters in Premium PC Cafes.  Keep it going until you receive some rewards!

0.0: Hi #b#h0##k!\n Have you heard of the Legendary Rubies? The Legendary Ruby is a red gem that's known to bring luck to its founder. Between now and TKTKTK, the #e#rLegendary Rubies#k#n will be given to the players who log into the game from the Premium PC Cafes. So, be sure to look for these Rubies while hunting monsters in Maple World!
